europe_now.title: Russian drone strike on Kyiv-area ammo warehouse kills dozens, forces evacuations
europe_now.summary: A Russian drone strike on an ammunition warehouse near Kyiv killed at least 37 people and forced hundreds to evacuate, with Ukrainian officials warning of a new ground assault on the capital. Ukraine's president said the facility stored munitions, and the attack hit residential areas.

europe_now.title: Germany preparing to formally attribute Leipzig attack to Russia
europe_now.summary: Germany is planning to publicly blame Russia for a deadly attack in Leipzig, escalating a sanctions and diplomatic dispute between Berlin and Moscow. The move would mark a sharp escalation in the confrontation between the two governments.

top_stories.title: Icelanders vote on resuming EU accession talks
top_stories.summary: Icelanders are voting in a referendum on whether to restart negotiations to join the European Union, a decision framed as an existential question for the country's foreign policy. The outcome could reopen a membership process Iceland froze years ago.

top_stories.title: EU moves to require AI chatbots in all official languages
top_stories.summary: The European Union is pushing to require AI chatbot services to support all of the bloc's official languages rather than operating primarily in English. The proposal is part of a broader push to make digital services accessible across member states.

top_stories.title: Serbia balances EU and Russia ties ahead of election
top_stories.summary: Serbia's government is weighing its relationships with both the European Union and Russia as a key national election approaches. The choice carries implications for the country's foreign policy orientation and its path toward EU integration.

top_stories.title: Norway's new king addresses nation after succession
top_stories.summary: Norway's newly ascended monarch delivered his first public speech, paying tribute to his late father and the outgoing king. The address marks the formal transition of the Norwegian royal household.
